classifications.rationale: The President reports to Congress that he issued a separate executive order; this segment does not itself modify the emergency or legal rights.
classifications.evidence: I hereby report that I have issued an Executive Order

classifications.rationale: The President recounts determinations, transmits the order, and describes an earlier finding; any operative consequence occurs in the separate orders, not this report.
classifications.evidence: I have enclosed a copy of the order.

classifications.rationale: The President retrospectively describes the emergency declaration and prohibitions imposed by Executive Order 13303; this segment does not presently impose them.
The President reports the legal effects of the separate new order and states a supporting finding; the report itself does not alter the protections.
classifications.evidence: The new order provides that protections granted by section 1 of Executive Order 13303

classifications.rationale: The President reports modifications, delegations, and implementation directions contained in or associated with the separate order; this congressional communication does not itself produce those effects.
classifications.evidence: Consequently, the order modifies the actions taken
